props.name: defaultCenter
props.comment: `[lat, lng]`. Read once at mount. Defaults to `[0, 0]`.

props.name: height
props.comment: In pixels, or any CSS length. Defaults to 400.

props.name: label
props.comment: The legend. A string is translated; `false` renders none.

props.name: quality
props.comment: The initial algorithm. `High` is slower and keeps more detail. Defaults to `Default`.

props.name: source
props.comment: The form field holding a Geometry, Feature or FeatureCollection.

props.name: tolerance
props.comment: The slider's initial value, in degrees. Defaults to 0.01.

props.name: zoom
props.comment: Read once at mount. Defaults to 13.
